text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: After today's staggered rollout we observed a small fraction of requests failing when the unpin job ran concurrently with a model promotion. The failure mode looks like a short-lived mismatch between router pinlist and version binder; manifests as 404s for recently promoted aliases. Proposing a short 'pin-orphan-protection' TTL extension on the recent unpin pins to avoid cascade until we land a guard. Thoughts?
Theo Barnes: Can you share a quick repro and which pins are involved? I want to avoid unnecessarily extending other unrelated pins.
Maya Chen: Repro in logs. Affected PINs: PIN-11234 and PIN-11235 which were scheduled to auto-unpin at TTL expiry. Window 12:04-12:12 UTC.
```
2026-07-04T12:06:07Z host=edge-2 request=gh12 status=404 router=pin_resolve error="alias-not-found after unpin for model=dialogue-x:stable"
2026-07-04T12:07:02Z host=edge-5 request=gh15 status=404 binder=version_bind error="promoted-alias not registered yet"
```
Ira S.: This smells like a race between the unpin removal and the promotion write. We should prefer extending the TTL for those specific pins for a short period while we push a durable commit to the binder and ensure router cache invalidation is ordered.
release-coordinator-bot: Proposed action: `/deploybot extend PIN-11234 hours=1 PIN-11235 hours=1 reason="prevent-cascade-until-binder-commit" initiated_by=@Maya Chen`
Maya Chen: Add an operator note to release-notes: "Extended TTL on PIN-11234/PIN-11235 to avoid alias-not-found during promotion commit sequence." Also coordinate with SRE on cache invalidation ordering.
deploybot: Extending pins...
deploybot: Extended: PIN-11234 ttl=3600s, PIN-11235 ttl=3600s initiated_by=Maya Chen. To unextend: `/deploybot shorten PIN-11234 PIN-11235`
eng-sre: Notifying SRE. We'll add an ordering guard to router cache invalidations in the next 30m and monitor 404s. Suppressing noisy alerts from affected route keys.
Theo Barnes: I'll open a small guard PR that ensures binder promotions write then invalidate router caches, with a durability fence on binder writes before unpins are applied. ETA ~45m for PR.
Ira S.: For immediate telemetry, set an alert that fires if alias-not-found 404s exceed 0.5% of total requests for any promoted alias over 5m. If it fires, we escalate and hold all upcoming unpins.
Maya Chen: Added a changelog/ops entry: PR https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/11234-11235-extend explaining short-term TTL extension and we notified CS about a potential blip.
release-coordinator-bot: Change window opened 12:15-14:15 UTC for binder guard and router cache ordering patch deployment.
Theo Barnes: After guard lands we'll coordinate a controlled unpin: unpin in router on edge nodes with an ordered staged announcement, then unpin binder record once router ack reached quorum. This should avoid orphan aliases.
eng-sre: We'll post telemetry snapshots (404 count, p95 latency) every 10m in this thread. If numbers are green for 30m after the guard, authorized to remove the TTL extension early.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Keeping this scoped to the two pins only. If you see similar signals for other promotions, call it out here and we'll extend as needed.
Ira S.: Also adding a small unit test in router to simulate binder promotion+unpin race so we don't regress.
Maya Chen: Sounds good. Once the test and guard are merged we'll coordinate a nighttime sweep to unpin any extended PINs and verify no regressions.
